sources.title: Security 51 Walkthrough — Day 1 to 14 (Level 1)
sources.version_boundary: Launch-build walkthrough; visitors explicitly described as randomized

claims.statement: The official checkpoint responsibilities include papers, passes, verbal orders, names, positions, clearance levels, time, and matching the number of people entering and leaving.
The player decides who may enter the elevator, who should be stopped, and who must not be allowed to leave the facility.
An official demo update confirms incorrect passport or pass numbers and forged medical certificates as inspection failures.
The observed launch route begins with name, number, portrait, approval or denial, and elevator operation, then adds stronger action overrides on later shifts.
Visitor identity and order are randomized, so a walkthrough cannot be used as a visitor-by-visitor permanent script.

unknowns: The official pages do not publish a permanent complete clearance table for every floor and shift.
The retained sources do not establish a universal visual recipe for every forged document in every patch.
Exact visitor order, earnings, and action frequency vary with randomization and player performance.
